tags.title: Tags
tags.description: How the Documents page groups the Documents, and every Tag of the Room. Each change is saved at once.

grouping.title: Grouping
grouping.description: The Documents page groups them by these items, in this order. An item is one Tag, or a combination: its Documents carry all those Tags.
grouping.empty: No items: Documents won't be grouped.
grouping.addHint: One Tag makes a Main Tag, two or more a combination.
grouping.alreadyMain: This Tag is already an item of the grouping.
grouping.alreadyCombination: This combination is already in the grouping.

all.title: All Tags
all.description: Deleting a Tag removes it from the Documents and the grouping; the Documents stay.

tags.confirmBody: The Tag is removed from every Document that has it and from the grouping. Combinations that used it shrink, and are removed if fewer than two Tags are left. Documents are not deleted. This cannot be undone.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Deleting the Room permanently removes it with its members, Documents, Comments, Notes and images.
dangerZone.confirmBody: Everything in this Room is deleted for everyone: members, invitations, Tags, Documents, Comments, Notes and images. This cannot be undone.

defaultVisibility.title: Default visibility
defaultVisibility.description: The level every new Document, Note and Comment starts at. A reply still starts from the visibility of the comment it answers. Existing content doesn't change.
defaultVisibility.label: Default visibility

history.title: Visibility history
history.description: Who changed who sees what, most recent change first.

formatHint.json: Structured data with ids, for tools and AI Agents.
formatHint.pdf: A manual-style document to print or hand to your players.
